Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft Mbh Has Decreased Its Stake in News New (NWSA) by $3.39 Million; Apple (AAPL) Stake Maintained by Grubman Wealth Management
May 19, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Grubman Wealth Management increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 167.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grubman Wealth Management bought 3,598 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 5,740 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $971,000, up from 2,142 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grubman Wealth Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $915.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $186.31. About 16.17 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft Mbh decreased its stake in News Corp New (NWSA) by 92.04% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft Mbh sold 211,610 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.12% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,303 shares of the newspapers and magazines company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $301,000, down from 229,913 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft Mbh who had been investing in News Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.70% or $0.11 during the last trading session, reaching $15.63. About 1.91 million shares traded. News Corporation (NASDAQ:NWSA) has risen 23.85% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.30% the S&P500.
Among 7 analysts covering News Corporation ( NASDAQ:NWSA ), 4 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 57% are positive. News Corporation had 15 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Jefferies maintained the shares of NWSA in report on Monday, September 11 with “Buy” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Monday, June 26. Jefferies maintained the shares of NWSA in report on Monday, October 16 with “Buy” rating. Bank of America downgraded News Corporation (NASDAQ:NWSA) on Thursday, October 27 to “Underperform” rating. The firm has “Outperform” rating by CLSA given on Tuesday, November 8. As per Monday, November 9, the company rating was downgraded by Wells Fargo. CLSA downgraded the shares of NWSA in report on Monday, May 9 to “Outperform” rating. The company was maintained on Thursday, February 8 by Jefferies. The rating was upgraded by Macquarie Research on Monday, July 27 to “Outperform”. The rating was maintained by Jefferies on Thursday, July 27 with “Buy”.
Analysts await News Corporation (NASDAQ:NWSA) to report earnings on August, 9. They expect $0.10 EPS, down 9.09% or $0.01 from last year’s $0.11 per share. NWSA’s profit will be $58.73M for 39.08 P/E if the $0.10 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.06 actual EPS reported by News Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 66.67% EPS growth.
Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft Mbh, which manages about $2.60 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Schwab Charles Corp New (NYSE:SCHW) by 9,061 shares to 57,077 shares, valued at $2.99M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Amgen Inc (NASDAQ:AMGN) by 21,798 shares in the quarter, for a total of 72,311 shares, and has risen its stake in Ebay Inc (NASDAQ:EBAY).
